AND b.id=1 AND b.state='verified' AND b.reference=?)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projection_run WHERE projection='enrichment' AND lease_id=? AND lease_until>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmdb_retirement_decision) BETWEEN ? AND ?) THEN ? END,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,? WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tmdb_retirement_decision WHERE request_id=? AND payload_json=?)
